label: End-of-episode D2 in S2 after a2 (common), following a rewarded S2 trial
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when S2 is shown after choosing a2 (common transition), only when the previous trial was rewarded, and only in the last ~10 trials of the episode (all activations at ep_trial 90-99, coinciding with the lowest value-head bin <5.2, i.e. the agent knows the episode is ending). Never fires on D1/GO, on S1, on rare transitions, or after unrewarded trials. Magnitude ramps up over consecutive a2->S2c rewarded trials and with ep_trial (strongest at trials 97-99; coverage of the predicate rises from 55% in the bottom activation quartile to 87% in the top). Activity is concentrated in episodes where S2 is good late (start_high=1, good=S2), i.e. long a2/S2 reward streaks. All predicate variables are observed at D2. ep_trial>=95 without prev_state gives higher mass recall (0.92) but lower F1 (0.56); precision is limited (~0.5-0.6) because many qualifying late-episode steps stay silent, especially early in a streak.
